correctness.rationale: On \(\Omega\le2\), divisor counts are exactly \(2,3,4\). Ordering a collision leaves only \((3,2),(4,2),(4,3)\); these give respectively \((4,5)\), the stated odd-semiprime/prime family, and an impossibility because \(8\mid p^2-1\) for odd \(p\) while a squarefree semiprime has \(\nu_2\le1\). The bundled scan through \(10^6\) reproduces every restricted fiber and finds no mismatch; it is not used for exhaustiveness.
